newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end down in a technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end down in a technical correction.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed down Monday in a technical correction following last week's gains, brokers said.
They added the market would likley remain broadly stable Tuesday.
Monday, the General Index fell 0.26 percent to 1,526.1 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index dropped 0.70 percent to 2,193.5 points.
In a total of 1,240 trades, volume was estimated at a modest 17.4 million soles ($6.7 million), brokers said.
"It is a technical correction, said Victor Heredia of local brokerage Fortuna. "There is no cause for concern as the underlying trend is positive."
Among leaders, benchmark Telefonica del Peru fell 1.75 percent, closing at 5.61 soles on volume of 986,000 shares.
Cement company Cementos Lima closed stable at 4.40 soles on volume of 165,000.
